blocks.text: A recovered notebook of local cancellation, exponential dynamics, dyadic limits and conditional transcendence, followed by the complete substance of the written-proof review.

blocks.label: The exact centre of this note
blocks.text: At the logistic two-cycle, the fourth-iterate displacement has zero first derivative and the cycle Lyapunov exponent is zero. These are precise local statements, with their derivations inside.

The surrounding threads retain their own definitions and assumptions. The note includes the two constructions of six, real and complex dimensions, the Schanuel-dependent Z(p) family, a Mahler-type series with an exact geometric remainder, ordinary-palindrome counting, alternating towers and prime-polynomial identities.

blocks.text: For cardinality, identify the reals with subsets of a countable set. A finite tuple of such subsets is encoded by a subset of finitely many disjoint copies of that set; their union is still countable. Equality of these set sizes does not identify vector-space dimension. Fractal dimension and physical degrees of freedom require their own definitions and structures.

The first is a standard polynomial factorization. For an odd positive integer n, the other two expressions represent different Collatz conventions: the unaccelerated odd step, and that step followed by one division by two. The full odd-to-odd Syracuse step removes every factor of two.

blocks.label: Conditional proposition
blocks.text: Assume the full complex Schanuel conjecture. For pairwise distinct odd integers p₁, …, pₖ ≥ 3, the numbers π, Z(p₁), …, Z(pₖ) are algebraically independent over ℚ.

“Algebraically independent” means that no nonzero polynomial with rational coefficients in these k + 1 variables vanishes on the tuple. The next page gives the deduction and keeps the assumption visible.

The exact zeta reduction is unconditional. This argument’s algebraic-independence conclusion, and hence its individual-transcendence conclusion for Z(p), remain conditional on Schanuel. The calculation does not prove the conjecture or change its evidential status.

blocks.label: What the number 40 means
blocks.text: In the displayed example, 40 is the sequence length n and the alphabet size is q = 4. Taking q = 40 defines a different abstract counting experiment. Neither calculation establishes a maximum sustainable DNA alphabet, a chemical stability threshold or an optimal decay rate.
Reversal and reverse complementation

A DNA reverse-complement palindrome is a different condition. Under a fixed-point-free complement pairing and the same uniform independent model, an even length has probability q<super>−n/2</super>; an odd length is impossible because its central symbol would have to complement itself.

The suggested synthetic-alphabet and biophysics thread therefore remains a research direction. It needs an explicit physical model, measurable stability criteria and suitable evidence beyond this combinatorial count.

A concrete next paper

The alternating-tower theorem, sharp envelope and two-base classification form a coherent short note: a clear domain, uniform convergence bound, complete proof and exact inverse classification. The productive next step is a focused novelty search and external review of that note.

For this treasure’s other branches, the immediate work is narrower: define T₀–T₃; identify which orbit means are relevant to the fractional exponential maps; and state a physical model before connecting alphabet counts to stability or decay.

blocks.label: Preserved conclusion
blocks.text: The inspected written proofs are valid within their stated scope and are elementary results of limited demonstrated research significance. Their existence deserves to be recorded accurately, without inflating either novelty or progress on the headline conjectures.
